# Windows-only expected failures. The ones shared with every other platform
# are in common.txt; README.md says what may go in either.

# No printer is installed on a hosted runner, so every one of these gets back
# "no default printer" instead of the value it asserts.
SysWin_xxx_Printer.testGroup/TEST_GETDEFAULTPRINTER_RET
SysWin_xxx_Printer.testGroup/TEST_SETDEFAULTPRINTER_RET_NEW_STYLE
SysWin_xxx_Printer.testGroup/TEST_SETDEFAULTPRINTER_RET_OLD_STYLE
SysWin_xxx_Printer.testGroup/TEST_SETDEFAULTPRINTER_SYNTAX2

# The test asserts that SysGetShortPathName returns an 8.3 name. Windows only
# generates those if 8dot3 name creation is enabled on the volume, and it is
# off by default on volumes other than the system one. The runner's workspace
# is on D:, so the call returns the long path unchanged: the assertion sees
# the full 259 characters where it wanted 34.
SysGetXxxPathName.testGroup/TEST_ARG_LIMIT
